title: Project Memory Frontmatter v1.0
description: YAML frontmatter for projects/{slug}/memory.md (spec §14, referenced from spec §3 file tree line: 'memory.md — project-memory.schema frontmatter + body'). Manager-style live document discipline: target file size <5KB total (frontmatter + body) so a fresh session can read it on wake without context bloat. Frontmatter pins the project's stable identity (slug, domain), audience and KPI targets that drive content/discovery skills, and the MCP scope white-list that constrains which tools any skill may invoke for this project. The free-form body below the frontmatter holds running notes (brand voice, open hypotheses, recent wins). Cross-references: project_slug must equal projects/{slug}/ directory and project-config.schema.json.project_id; mcp_scope entries must exist in mcp-tool-registry.schema.json. NOTE: spec §14 details the manager docs (PHASE_STATUS, OPEN_QUESTIONS, DECISIONS, SESSION_PROTOCOL, REFERENCE_INDEX) but does not enumerate exact memory.md frontmatter fields — these fields are the conservative minimum set sufficient to drive v1 skills; expansions require an ADR.

project_slug.description: Project identifier. Must equal projects/{slug}/ directory name and project-config.schema.json.project_id. kebab-case only.

domain.description: Primary site identity. Either a bare hostname (e.g. 'example.com') or a short brand label when the site is multi-domain. Used by GSC/SF/DFS skills as the property/site key.

target_audience.description: Short labels describing the primary audience segments (e.g. ['dentists-tr', 'dental-clinic-managers']). Drives tone-of-voice and intent matching in content skills.

kpis.description: Tracked key performance indicators with numeric targets and source of truth. Used by monthly-report skill to render the KPI table; cross-checked by drift-check.

target.description: Numeric goal (e.g. 12000) or qualitative target string (e.g. '+15% MoM'). Strings are accepted for ratio/qualitative KPIs.

source.description: Where the actual value is read from. Conventions: 'gsc', 'dataforseo', 'master.xlsx#sheet', 'manual'.

mcp_scope.description: White-list of MCP tools any skill may call for this project. Entries match mcp-tool-registry.schema.json fully-qualified tool names. Empty/absent means use plugin defaults.

last_updated.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp set whenever the manager rewrites memory.md. Lets stale-detection skills warn when a project hasn't been touched in N days.
